description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok E-commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:


 Support the creator education strategy for TikTok Shop, including the design and production of educational content (videos, guides, tutorials) aimed at improving content quality and platform knowledge.
 Set up, write, and execute creator communications across channels such as Push, Inbox, WhatsApp, and Email, including copywriting, message setup, and campaign deployment, ensuring proper segmentation, clarity, and performance focus (CTR, OR).
 Own the management and day-to-day operations of WhatsApp creator communities, including content sharing, moderation, follow-ups, and coordination around key initiatives.
 Collaborate closely with content agencies to coordinate deliverables, review scripts, provide feedback, and ensure alignment with marketing and performance objectives.
 Support the execution and follow-up of key TikTok Shop campaigns (e.g., competitions, missions, and special initiatives), ensuring educational and communication materials are correctly implemented across channels.
 Research and analyze creator education and marketing strategies from other markets to propose improvements and adaptations.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related major.
 Strong interest in digital content, creator marketing, TikTok, and the e-commerce ecosystem.
 Solid communication skills, strategic thinking, and a results-oriented mindset.
 Experience or strong interest in content production (video, scripting, copywriting), ideally with familiarity with TikTok-style content.


Preferred Qualifications:


 Familiarity with TikTok content ecosystem, shoppable content, and brand-creator partnerships is a plus


For TikTok

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

Acerca de Kavak

Somos la empresa de tecnología que está revolucionando la compra y venta de autos usados en Latinoamérica desde el 2016. Después de 7 años de funcionamiento, Kavak se ha convertido en la startup tecnológica más valorada de América Latina, formalizando el negocio de autos usados en mercados emergentes,con operaciones en México, Brasil, Argentina, Chile y Medio Oriente.

Nuestra misión es potenciar la vida de las personas a través del acceso a un automóvil. Desbloqueamos el poder transformador que tiene un auto para que las personas puedan simplemente disfrutar del viaje.

Provide your expected compensation while applying

Mission of OpenSolar:

"OpenSolar’s mission is simple: to make the best solar operating system accessible to every installer, anywhere, without the burden of expensive software licenses. By connecting installers to customers and the world’s leading providers of products and services, and by offering our AI-powered platform for free, we enable them to reinvest their resources into their businesses, driving efficiencies that will power the future of solar."

You have +5 years experience in Marketing.

English - Fully fluent

About Us:

OpenSolar was founded in 2017 by global pioneers in solar software - Andrew Birch and Adam Pryor. OpenSolar exists to accelerate the adoption of solar and renewable energy globally. We provide the world's clean energy professionals with an end-to-end digital design, sales and management software to grow their businesses, free of charge.




OpenSolar is driven by its mission to accelerate the adoption of solar for a world powered by sunshine by 2050. We stay focused on our mission by obsessing over the experience of our end users, being open and honest, solving problems through careful and deliberate design, and by keeping things simple.




OpenSolar is a truly global organization with our team spread across 16 countries and our user base spread over 180+ countries. 




At OpenSolar, we are dedicated to cultivating a workplace that celebrates diversity and

promotes inclusivity. Our goal is to build a team that is reflective of the communities we serve, recognising that diversity brings strength and richness to our organisation. We believe that everyone should feel empowered to bring their authentic selves to work and we are committed to creating an environment where all employees are valued, respected, and supported. We actively seek to attract and retain a talented workforce that represents the breadth of our society. We provide equal opportunities for everyone to thrive and advance in their careers, enabling them to achieve their full potential.




This is your opportunity to be part of the clean energy movement, creating a lasting impact on the world. All while being part of a passionate, fun, and highly collaborative team.




The Role:

OpenSolar offers its platform free to solar contractors and generates revenue through industry partners who sell products and services inside the software. The Growth/Monetization function helps expand those revenue streams and ensures teams across OpenSolar apply a “monetization lens” to the value we create.




We’re hiring a Marketing Lead for the Americas. You’ll own integrated marketing strategy and execution for the North American market, driving campaigns that grow installer engagement, partner visibility, and platform monetization. This role reports to the Global Head of Marketing.




In this role, you’ll design and execute integrated marketing campaigns for OpenSolar’s solar professional user base across the USA and Canada. You’ll also work directly with North American partners to grow their presence on the platform through co- marketing and paid campaign initiatives.




It’s an excellent fit for someone who is highly organized, creative, and skilled at communicating sophisticated technology to busy professionals. In this high-visibility role, you will work closely with executive leaders and be a key player in the design and delivery of strategic projects.




What you’ll own:

Integrated Campaigns & GTM

• Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns for solar installers across the USA and Canada, spanning email, social, web, paid search, in-platform, and partner channels

• Own regional campaign planning and communications calendars, ensuring coordinated execution across teams, channels, and markets

• Launch and promote new OpenSolar features and initiatives to drive installer awareness, engagement, and platform adoption

• Collaborate with product, sales, growth, and creative teams to develop compelling

messaging and campaign assets tailored to the North American market

• Create and manage campaign content including landing pages, blogs, newsletters, press releases, and customer communications




Partner Marketing

• Oversee the delivery of paid marketing packages sold to North American partners to

ensure high-quality campaign delivery and strong partner experience

• Collaborate with finance, manufacturing, and distribution partners to design and execute co-marketing campaigns that grow partner visibility and engagement with solar installers




Regional Growth, Events & PR

• Own the planning and execution of OpenSolar’s regional conference and industry event presence, including booth activations, marketing collateral, and partner engagement

• Develop regional customer advocacy initiatives, including installer testimonials, case

studies, and success stories

• Identify and execute regional PR and award submission opportunities




Performance & Insights

• Partner with the business intelligence team to measure campaign performance, installer engagement, and regional growth trends, using insights and market feedback to continuously improve messaging, targeting, and campaign effectiveness




What you’ll need:

Marketing Skills:

• 5+ years of marketing experience, preferably B2B and/or SaaS experience in solar/clean energy

• Proven track record in designing and executing localized marketing campaigns

• Experience in partner marketing is strongly preferred

• Proven experience in marketing campaign measurement and ROI analysis

• Working knowledge of Canva, CRM (ideally Hubspot), and CMS (WordPress)

• Familiarity with SEO/AEO




Other skills:

• Experience working with product management and web development teams to build

campaign assets such as landing pages and OpenSolar Expo stands

• Strong ability to self-motivate and innovate without waiting for direction

• Project management skills to manage matrixed cross-functional teams

• Excellent relationship building skills and the ability to establish trusted, collaborative

relationships with our many global and local partners




What we bring:

• A Passionate, Driven, and Highly Collaborative Team: Join a team that is dedicated to

making a difference, where collaboration and passion drive our success.

• Mission-Focused Organization with a Well-being-Led Culture: We prioritize both our

mission to drive clean energy solutions and the well-being of our team members, fostering a supportive and healthy work environment.

• Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive Work Environment: We celebrate diversity and

inclusivity, creating a workplace where everyone's contributions are valued and

respected.

• Professional Development and Support for Your Growth: We invest in your

development with opportunities for learning and advancement, supporting your career journey.

• Constant Exposure to New Opportunities: Experience a dynamic work environment

where you'll encounter cutting-edge technology solutions and innovative projects.

the clean energy sector, leveraging state-of-the-art technology to drive impactful change.

• Flexible Leave Options: Enjoy flexibility to manage your life-work priorities with leave options that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Opportunity to Create a Lasting Impact: Be part of the clean energy movement and

contribute to a sustainable future, making a meaningful impact on a global scale.

skills: Driving organic traffic growth for client accounts — implementing on-page SEO best practices, advanced keyword research, technical optimizations, and site structure improvements that produce measurable ranking results.
Evaluating website traffic and rankings using GA, GSC, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and GBP — identifying growth opportunities, diagnosing issues, and translating data into clear action plans.
Implementing internal linking strategies, keyword cannibalization diagnoses, competitor analyses, and full website audits — going deep into every account to find what others miss.
Developing and executing Local SEO strategies and GEO initiatives — building tactics to improve rankings in local search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, and LLM visibility.

Collaborating with SEOs, content writers, designers, and developers on new experiments, client deliverables, and ongoing optimization work — contributing to a culture of testing and continuous improvement.
Experimenting with new SEO tactics, challenging the status quo, and pushing the boundaries of what drives results — this team rewards curiosity and evidence-based thinking over industry consensus.
Attending SEO conferences and webinars, staying current on algorithm updates and emerging trends, and bringing new insights back to the team proactively.
Working directly with clients — understanding the true need behind every request, communicating findings clearly, and recommending the best path forward even when it requires challenging assumptions.
3+ years of hands-on SEO experience — with demonstrated, proven ability to rank pages and websites. Theoretical knowledge is great, but this team wants to see real results.

2+ years of client-facing experience in an SEO agency environment — you know how to manage client expectations, communicate complex SEO concepts clearly, and uncover the real need behind every request.
Advanced proficiency with GA, GSC, and GBP — and strong working knowledge of Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and equivalent SEO tools.
Proven ability to execute both short-term and long-term SEO strategies — you know when to go for quick wins and when to build for sustained organic growth.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you are comfortable in the uncertainty of algorithm changes and thrive on finding patterns where others see noise.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, and deliver consistent results in a fully remote environment.
Bonus: experience building and growing your own website — nothing teaches SEO like having your own rankings on the line.
Bonus: experience with digital PR, link building, or off-site SEO strategies.
Bonus: comfort with WordPress or other CMS platforms, and basic HTML/CSS knowledge.
Bonus: experience in the automotive vertical or with local SEO for multi-location businesses.
Bonus: good eye for UX and web design — understanding how user experience and SEO interact.
To be considered for this role, you must be currently based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.
💸 Competitive salary in USD — paid consistently every month, no matter where you are.
🌴 10 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.
💻 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.
📈 True ownership over strategy and execution — with the freedom to experiment, test, and prove your ideas in a team that rewards curiosity and results over convention.

🏆 A collaborative, high-growth culture inside an award-winning digital marketing agency — where continuous learning, healthy debate, and real experimentation are part of how the team operates every day.

🤝 A supportive environment through Veta Virtual and our client — with a clear path to growth, access to SEO conferences and webinars, and a team that genuinely invests in making you better at your craft.
description:
About the job

Launch Your Next Successful Chapter with Veta Virtual! 🚀

💸 Competitive Salary in USD | 🌍 100% Remote | 📈 Real SEO Ownership | 🏆 Award-Winning Agency Culture

Veta Virtual is hiring an SEO Specialist for one of our high-growth clients in the Digital Marketing industry — an award-winning, fully remote SEO agency specializing in the automotive vertical with a track record of delivering 70%+ organic traffic increases within six months. This is not a checklist role. It is a thinking role — built for someone who is analytical, curious, and genuinely energized by the challenge of ranking websites in an ever-changing search landscape. If you love testing ideas, questioning assumptions, and proving results rather than just theorizing about them, this role was made for you.

🔑 Your Role

As an SEO Specialist, you will have true ownership over both strategy and execution for a portfolio of automotive client accounts — with the freedom to think critically, challenge conventional wisdom, experiment with new approaches, and see the direct impact of your work on real rankings and real traffic growth. You will report to the Assistant SEO Manager and collaborate closely with a team of SEOs, writers, designers, and developers who love healthy debate and genuine experimentation. Driving organic traffic growth for client accounts — implementing on-page SEO best practices, advanced keyword research, technical optimizations, and site structure improvements that produce measurable ranking results.
Evaluating website traffic and rankings using GA, GSC, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and GBP — identifying growth opportunities, diagnosing issues, and translating data into clear action plans.
Implementing internal linking strategies, keyword cannibalization diagnoses, competitor analyses, and full website audits — going deep into every account to find what others miss.
Developing and executing Local SEO strategies and GEO initiatives — building tactics to improve rankings in local search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, and LLM visibility.
Collaborating with SEOs, content writers, designers, and developers on new experiments, client deliverables, and ongoing optimization work — contributing to a culture of testing and continuous improvement.
Experimenting with new SEO tactics, challenging the status quo, and pushing the boundaries of what drives results — this team rewards curiosity and evidence-based thinking over industry consensus.
Attending SEO conferences and webinars, staying current on algorithm updates and emerging trends, and bringing new insights back to the team proactively.
Working directly with clients — understanding the true need behind every request, communicating findings clearly, and recommending the best path forward even when it requires challenging assumptions.


✅ What You'll Need


3+ years of hands-on SEO experience — with demonstrated, proven ability to rank pages and websites. Theoretical knowledge is great, but this team wants to see real results.
2+ years of client-facing experience in an SEO agency environment — you know how to manage client expectations, communicate complex SEO concepts clearly, and uncover the real need behind every request.
Advanced proficiency with GA, GSC, and GBP — and strong working knowledge of Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and equivalent SEO tools.
Proven ability to execute both short-term and long-term SEO strategies — you know when to go for quick wins and when to build for sustained organic growth.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you are comfortable in the uncertainty of algorithm changes and thrive on finding patterns where others see noise.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, and deliver consistent results in a fully remote environment.
Bonus: experience building and growing your own website — nothing teaches SEO like having your own rankings on the line.
Bonus: experience with digital PR, link building, or off-site SEO strategies.
Bonus: comfort with WordPress or other CMS platforms, and basic HTML/CSS knowledge.
Bonus: experience in the automotive vertical or with local SEO for multi-location businesses.
Bonus: good eye for UX and web design — understanding how user experience and SEO interact.
To be considered for this role, you must be currently based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.


💼 What We Offer

ilustrator, Redacción creativa, Ortografía, Marketing digital, Gestión de comunidades digitales, Edición de video, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Canva, Elaboración de informes

Confianza

Innovación

Definir y ejecutar la visión estratégica de Diseño de Producto para la Dirección Digital, liderando un equipo de alto rendimiento en el diseño de productos y servicios digitales que no solo

satisfagan las necesidades de los usuarios, sino que también generen un impacto significativo en los objetivos de negocio y fortalezcan la marca digital.

• Liderar, mentorear y desarrollar equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño de producto, establecer estándares de calidad, mejores prácticas y procesos eficientes para fomentar un equipo de alto

rendimiento, innovador y cohesivo, que pueda escalar y responder eficazmente a las demandas del negocio, asegurando la entrega constante de soluciones de diseño de producto de calidad superior.

• Gestionar y supervisar la investigación de enfoque en usuarios y el análisis de mercado incluyendo la implementación de metodologías como entrevistas, pruebas de usabilidad, encuestas y análisis de datos para obtener una comprensión profunda de las necesidades, comportamientos y puntos de dolor de los usuarios.

• Desarrollar y monitorear métricas clave de diseño de producto y KPIS, utilizando los datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora y validar el impacto de las iniciativas de diseño para medir objetivamente el éxito de las implementaciones de diseño de producto, optimizar continuamente la experiencia digital y demostrar el valor tangible del diseño centrado en el usuario para el retorno de inversión del negocio tanto cualitativa como cuantitativa.

• Supervisar el ciclo de vida completo del diseño de producto, desde la conceptualización y wireframing hasta la creación de prototipos y pruebas de usabilidad con usuarios reales para garantizar que los productos y servicios digitales sean intuitivos, eficientes y agradables de usar, lo que mejora la satisfacción del cliente, reduce las fricciones y optimiza las métricas clave de negocio como la conversión y la retención.

• Implementar y comunicar la visión y estrategia de diseño de producto para todos los productos y servicios digitales para asegurar una experiencia de usuario coherente y de clase mundial que alinee el diseño con los objetivos de negocio y la visión global, facilitar para generar talleres, sprints de diseño y revisiones de partes interesadas.

• Planear y gestionar las necesidades de los usuarios, los objetivos de negocio y las capacidades tecnológicas, integrando estos elementos de manera fluida dentro del ciclo de desarrollo ágil.

• Analizar y utilizar datos avanzados (analytics, heatmaps, A/B testing) para informar las decisiones de diseño, validar el impacto de las soluciones y optimizar continuamente la experiencia del usuario.

Job Title: Remote E-Commerce Product Manager (100% Work From Home) 




Location: Remote from Latin America




Position Type: Full Time




Salary: $3,000 – $4,000 USD/month (Determined based on e-commerce catalog management experience and technical systems depth).




Schedule: Full-Time, 40 hours/week. Requires consistent operational overlap with US Mountain Time (MT). Critical Shift Pattern: Because global product drops originate overnight from Asia, this role strictly requires availability on Sunday through Friday evenings (Mountain Time) to capture real-time international announcements and execute immediate preorder launches. Schedules are flexible during off-peak volume periods, but unwavering reliability during launch windows is essential.







About our Client




Our Client is one of the fastest-growing specialty music and pop-culture subculture retailers in the United States. Operating a high-velocity omni-channel ecosystem that spans enterprise Shopify builds, massive TikTok Shop pipelines, and a flagship physical retail flagship in Denver, Colorado, they manage thousands of rotating SKUs across multiple digital frontends. Characterized by rapid weekly product launches, highly competitive limited-edition releases, and immediate pricing adjustments, they run a demanding, hyper-organized e-commerce engine optimizing for speed and market dominance.




The Role




Our Client is seeking an analytical, process-driven E-commerce Product Manager to take end-to-end strategic and operational ownership of their multi-channel product catalogs. Please note: This is not a task-executing Virtual Assistant position. Our client has outgrown basic administrative execution; they are hiring a system-builder who has previously owned Shopify storefronts and coordinated cross-functional product rollouts. The successful candidate will own the entire operational lifecycle of every asset—orchestrating international preorders, managing platform synchronization, standardizing data processes, and serving as the operational connective tissue across the warehouse, marketing, design, customer support, and administrative virtual assistant squads.

Shopify Architecture & Multi-Channel Catalog Governance

Transitions product statuses meticulously from "Preorder" to "In-Stock" configurations as logistics clear warehouse checkpoints.

Owns the TikTok Shop ecosystem natively: publishing optimized assets, maintaining extreme catalog quality metrics, synchronizing pricing matrices, troubleshooting platform indexing errors, and ensuring absolute compliance against algorithmic safety parameters.

Serves as the central operational router coordinating project dependencies across internal warehouses, brick-and-mortar storefronts, marketing arms, creative design teams, and outsourced virtual assistants.
Translates chaotic e-commerce behaviors into pristine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), documenting automated routines and pricing validation steps.

AI Tool Integration: Complete comfort using generative AI systems (Claude/ChatGPT) as a core daily instrument to maximize operational copywriting and administrative analysis speed.
Language Precision: Absolute fluency in written and verbal English, characterized by strong technical copywriting habits and process-documentation habits.

We think big

We come as we are

We are built on trust

The Role



SimplePractice is hiring for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team in a hybrid role. The ideal candidate will have expert-level knowledge in Ruby on Rails and extensive backend development experience. As one of the first hires in our brand-new Mexico City location, you will play a pivotal role in helping us build a team of software developers who are passionate about what they do.

Build out the next generation practice management platform

Collaborate with our Product group to help understand customer needs, troubleshoot potential problems and define upcoming features
Write clean, efficient and well-tested code that improves our code base in meaningful ways
Help diagnose problems and architect solutions



Desired Skills & Experience



You have 2 to 5 years of engineering experience, with hands-on Ruby on Rails expertise for a part of your career
You're proficient in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills
You have a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
You possess solid experience in at least one modern JavaScript framework, specifically Ember.js or React.js, and the ecosystem around those frameworks
You have designed and implemented large, scalable web applications and have an appreciation for clean, elegant, and simple code
You have experience taking Rails apps from idea to production
You understand the value and nuances of Test-Driven Development
You're comfortable working with remote teams, using GitHub, Slack, Notion, and Zoom to collaborate



Bonus Points



You’re excited about holding a lead role to help us scale a brand new software developer office

Experience with compliance standards PCI/HIPAA

About the job

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

The Role

As our affiliate manager, you will be the driving force behind our global expansion, taking full ownership of the affiliate strategy. Your mission is to accelerate international growth by building a high-performing network of partners that positions Holafly as the top choice for global connectivity. By managing affiliate relationships and tapping into regional trends, you’ll expand our brand presence and deliver measurable results in the Spanish and LATAM markets

Identify and actively recruit new affiliate partners and revenue drivers. Own a curated portfolio of affiliate partners, building individual account plans and executing quarterly growth roadmaps for them.

skills: Combinar los fundamentos de la pedagogía con las estrategias del diseño instruccional para crear experiencias de aprendizaje efectivas y centradas en el estudiante.
Potenciar la excelencia académica mediante el acompañamiento integral, la capacitación continua y la estandarización de procesos pedagógicos.

Diseño instruccional: Realizar el diseño instruccional de metodologías innovadoras (flipped classroom, dinámicas de clases, gamificación, casos, etc.). Diseñar guías pedagógicas que integren la experimentación, investigación, exploración y conclusión vs resultado final.
Análisis y Diagnóstico: Identificar las necesidades de aprendizaje de los usuarios y definir los objetivos pedagógicos.

Diseño de Estrategias: Estructurar el contenido educativo utilizando metodologías innovadoras (como e-learning, aprendizaje basado en proyectos o gamificación) para facilitar la adquisición de conocimientos.
Desarrollo de Materiales: Crear recursos didácticos multimedia, guías, evaluaciones y entornos virtuales que apoyen el proceso de enseñanza.
Implementación y Evaluación: Supervisar la puesta en marcha de los programas educativos y evaluar su impacto para realizar mejoras continuas.
Consolidación de procesos y lineamientos institucionales
Estandarización: Definir y unificar los procesos críticos: cartas temáticas, Syllabus, criterios de retroalimentación a alumnos, estándares de investigación y calidad de entregas finales.
Recursos: Asegurar que lxs docentes cuenten con los recursos necesarios y ecosistema operativo ideal para la impartición de clases.
Cumplimiento y Mentoría: Dar seguimiento activo al cumplimiento de reglamentos y lineamientos institucionales, acompañando al docente en su proceso de adopción normativa
Acompañamiento y capacitación Docente:

Plan de Capacitación: Diseñar planes de capacitación por ciclo escolar a través de la identificación de necesidades (evaluación docente, dirección del programa, retroalimentación, etc) estableciendo claramente por programa académico los alcances y los aprendizajes esperados.

Onboarding y ADN docente: Co-liderar, junto con la Dirección de Ámbito docente, la inducción pedagógica y normativa de los docentes al inicio de cada ciclo. Identificar en esta planeación los módulos de la Especialidad en Educación en los que deben capacitarse para cumplir con los objetivos pedagógicos de la institución..

Plataformas: Realizar un análisis de los niveles de usuario de nuestrxs docentes, planificar la capacitación en función de estos niveles, acompañar lxs docente para alcanzar el 100% del uso eficiente de las mismas.
Evaluación docente e investigación

Evaluación docente: Garantizar que cada programa alcance al menos el 90% de participación estudiantil en evaluaciones docentes. Analizar los resultados y elaborar por ciclo escolar un informe con los resultados cuantitativos y cualitativos detallados.

Seguimiento evaluación docente: Asegurar que los directores de programa ejecuten la retroalimentación formal con sus docentes basada en los hallazgos Identificar de estos resultados capacitaciones y/o acompañamiento docente.
Escucha Activa: Implementar técnicas de evaluación, Focus Groups y entrevistas con estudiantes y egresadxs para diagnosticar fortalezas y debilidades del aprendizaje académico.
Visión Innovadora: Capacidad para integrar tecnología y pedagogía de vanguardia.
Adaptabilidad y Creatividad: Para proponer dinámicas de clase que rompan con lo tradicional y fomenten la innovación.
Comunicación Asertiva: Para dar retroalimentación y gestionar conflictos con perfiles académicos.
Pensamiento Analítico: Capacidad para transformar datos de encuestas en planes de acción concretos.
Actitud de servicio.
Atención al detalle: Para asegurar que los reglamentos y lineamientos se cumplan sin errores.
Licenciatura: Pedagogía o Ciencias de la Educación.
Posgrado: Maestría en Innovación Educativa, Tecnología Educativa u otras maestrías afines.
Certificaciones deseables:
Diplomado en Diseño Instruccional o Metodologías Activas (Gamificación, Aula Invertida, Aprendizaje Basado en Proyectos) o Metodologías ágiles.
Conocimientos en normatividad educativa vigente (acreditaciones, registros de validez oficial).
Gestión de Calidad Educativa: Análisis de indicadores (KPIs), encuestas de satisfacción y procesos de evaluación docente.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the internet." Stripes leverage their understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

The role of Ops Associate can be interpreted as a Stripe "athlete" that will engage in either internal-facing or external-facing (e.g., support, risk) workflows, or both. OA roles will be highly operational in nature and will largely be aligned with case-level or process-type work. OAs will work on workflows which are considered to be "medium complexity" or sensitive in nature, therefore requiring internal Stripe-level systems and tools access, meaning that it cannot be outsourced. As the SDC matures and capability is established, we can expect the complexity of work at SDC to increase, and additionally aspire to drive improvements in the work we are responsible for.

Responsibilities


Deliver exceptional Stripe experience by efficiently and accurately resolving issues across social media platforms (e.g., X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and others)
Help resolve issues that are escalated via social media, including technical product questions, and work to prevent those issues from happening again
Partner with internal teams across Stripe (e.g., Comms, Incident Ops, Risk), serving as the ultimate escalation point for high-stakes user issues and proactively initiating incident reports with a user-first mindset
Coordinate executive escalations from Stripe's leaders with other teams
Contribute to and manage new programs focused on improving the Stripe user experience
Identify operational process gaps and initiate continuous improvements to accelerate global scale while delivering an exceptional experience for Stripe users
Be part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have experience with social media support or an interest in resolving user issues through those channels (e.g., Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook).
You have prior experience in customer support and external user-facing operations.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems, leveraging a process-oriented approach and a curiosity for technical products.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off in lieu. The SDC operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Prior experience or technical proficiency with Sprinklr will be an added advantage.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.




Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.




Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail




What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.




Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.




Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.
Using AI to accelerate research and synthesis.
Rethinking traditional research methods through AI rather than simply replicating existing processes.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.




Skills




Consumer research
Strategic thinking

Pattern recognition
Cultural analysis
Storytelling
AI literacy
Project management
Cross-functional collaboration




Mindset




We're looking for someone who:

Is endlessly curious about people.
Naturally connects dots that others miss.
Questions assumptions before accepting them.
Loves experimenting with AI.
Enjoys building systems, not just reports.
Thinks like a strategist, not only a researcher.
Wants to help build a capability that doesn't yet exist.




Why Join Sarelly?




This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

Rather than inheriting traditional research processes, you'll help define how AI and human judgment work together to create a structural competitive advantage for one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands in the market.

description:
About the job

WHO WE ARE

At Kidoz, we build privacy-first technology that helps brands and app developers connect with mobile audiences in a way that’s safe, thoughtful, and effective. We focus on contextual advertising - not tracking people or collecting personal data - because we believe relevance shouldn’t come at the expense of trust.

 

We’re a growing, globally distributed team of builders and problem-solvers who care about doing things the right way. Our platform reaches hundreds of millions of users each month, and we’re proud to work with partners who value both performance and responsibility. If you’re excited about modern adtech with strong principles and real impact, you’ll feel at home here.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You'll be responsible for driving programmatic growth and troubleshooting across Open Market and YouTube discovery, while supporting the broader AdOps team in delivering campaigns with strong performance and accuracy. You'll also maintain a proactive, collaborative relationship with the tech team, providing whatever support they need to keep integrations and delivery running smoothly.

 

This role:

• Partners with the Head of Programmatic and cross-functional teams to execute high-impact campaigns, consistently exceeding client KPIs while delivering premium account support.

• Designs and executes A/B tests across diverse programmatic platforms to uncover performance blockers, working closely with tech teams to resolve them.

• Maintains proactive communication with the technical team to unlock blockers in our programmatic ecosystem and troubleshoot new verticals to grow.

• Sets up campaigns within SSP platforms such as Pubmatic, Xandr, and others, to maximize traffic to the accounts that need it.

• Develops, implements, and A/B test programmatic in-app ad campaigns on both Kidoz and DV360/CM360 platforms.

• Escalates campaign blockers immediately to ensure all deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

• Produces reports that show campaign performance and results to share internally and externally with clients.

 




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR




In your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

Consistent A/B testing across programmatic campaign types to identify and drive growth in new verticals.
Smooth, well-documented pathways that unblock incremental revenue in Open Market campaigns and YouTube discovery.
Strong support to the Programmatic AdOps team in successfully delivering campaigns for Key Accounts.
Strong internal communication with the tech team to build confidence in campaign execution.
Clear and consistent reporting on campaign results and optimization strategies.
Contribution to improved operational processes and QA standards within AdOps.

 




WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

You’re analytical, detail-oriented, and highly organized. You thrive in fast-paced AdTech environments and are comfortable balancing technical troubleshooting with partner-facing communication. You’re proactive in identifying issues and confident collaborating across technical and commercial teams.

 

You have:

• Experience managing programmatic Open Market and other campaign types within a digital advertising or AdTech environment.

• Hands-on experience working with SSP platforms and ORTB integrations.

• Open market monetization knowledge from the supply side.

• Experience with YouTube monetization through DV360 or Google Ads.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across live campaigns.

• Expertise in interpreting complex performance data, with a specialized ability to troubleshoot the root causes of discrepancies and implement effective optimizations.

• Comfort working with technical tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms.

• Strong communication with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

• Experience managing Jira or similar ticketing systems.

• Comfort working cross-functionally across AdOps, Sales, Tech, and Data teams.

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) - this is essential for daily collaboration across our distributed team.

 




HOW WE OPERATE

We work in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where priorities can shift. We value clear communication, ownership, and people who are comfortable balancing structure with flexibility. 




GOOD TO KNOWS

• This is an independent contractor engagement at a full-time capacity.

• You must be based in and working out of Eastern Time (EST - UTC-3 to UTC-5).

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

• Kidoz is a globally distributed team - you’ll collaborate regularly with teammates across Europe and the West Coast.

• Experience in ad tech or familiarity with advertising technology is essential for this role.

• This role comes with meaningful ownership and room to shape how we work, not just follow existing playbooks.




COMPENSATION

You’ll be joining as an independent contractor at a full-time capacity. Compensation is competitive and based on experience and scope of responsibility. We pay fairly, transparently, and in line with the impact you have. We review compensation regularly and aim to grow roles and rewards as the company grows.





OUR HIRING PROCESS




We try to keep our hiring process straightforward, thoughtful, and human. For this role, you will have:

• Round 1: An initial conversation with our team.

• Round 2: An interview with the hiring manager and a cross-functional partner.

• Round 3: A practical scenario-based discussion.

• Round 4: A final conversation with senior leadership.

 

We value clear communication and aim to move efficiently while making sure there’s mutual alignment on both sides.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As Vendor Manager, you'll work with different vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 5+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience

 Bachelor's Degree.

Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job Type: Contract

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Web Browsing Evaluator to work on a contract basis. • Assess the relevance and accuracy of web search results based on specific queries and user intent.

• Evaluate the quality of web pages, including content accuracy, usability, and adherence to search engine guidelines.

• Provide detailed feedback on the browsing experience, including page load times, navigation, and overall user satisfaction.

• Identify and report issues such as broken links, outdated content, or misleading information in search results.

• Follow structured evaluation guidelines to ensure consistency and reliability in assessments.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ability to follow detailed written instructions and provide constructive feedback.

• Familiarity with web browsing, search engines, and basic understanding of how search algorithms function.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate content for accuracy and relevance.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote setting.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the improvement of search engine accuracy and user experience. Evaluators play a critical role in refining how information is delivered to users worldwide.
